summary: This is a preliminary prospectus supplement filed under Rule 424(b)(5) by Ameriprise Financial, Inc. for a public offering of senior notes with two tranches, amounts and rates to be determined. The notes are unsecured senior debt, not guaranteed by subsidiaries, and not exchange-listed. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. Underwriters include BofA Securities, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo Securities.
